Start date: 1883-09-02  
Subtract 27 weeks and 5 days = 27×7 + 5 = 194 days.  

1883-09-02 minus 194 days:  
September has 2 days back to Sep 1 → 1 day used.  
Remaining 193 days go into previous months.  
August (31) + July (31) + June (30) + May (31) + April (30) + March (31) + February (28) = 212 days from Mar 1 to Sep 1.  
We need to go back 193 days from Sep 1: 212 - 193 = 19 days left in February after going back to Mar 1.  
So from Sep 1, go back to Mar 1 (184 days), then need 9 more days back into February: 28 - 9 = 19 → date is 1883-02-19.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1883-02-19
